headline: Sorek Power Station Consortium Closes NIS 5.6B Financing
summary: The consortium behind the Sorek power station project closed approximately NIS 5.6 billion in financing, led by Mizrahi Tefahot Bank and Discount Bank.
why: Large infrastructure and energy projects require syndicated bank financing to fund construction and long-term development.

impacts.name: Israeli Banking Sector
impacts.why: Major project financing syndications involve substantial capital commitments from participating commercial banks.
